name: Arvind Ltd
title: Arvind Ltd - 500101 - Transcript Of AAML''s Acquisition Investor Call

read.thesis: Arvind buys 61% of US needle-punch nonwovens maker Dalco-GFT at 7.75x CY25 EBITDA (EV ~$136m) with 85% utilisation, adding a line for ~$5m capex a year and targeting mid-teens growth.

utilisation.quote: Utilization is around 85% of the capacity.

capex.quote: There is already a plan to put in approximately $5 million of capex every year.

triggers.label: Utilisation 85%, lines added
triggers.quote: Because we are at 85% capacity utilization, and we will do a $5 million capex every year, we should be able to grow in the mid-teens

triggers.label: Revenue growth 10–12%, margin mid-teens
triggers.quote: we will continue to maintain that 10% to 12% revenue growth and mid-teens margin expansion or margin growth rather

triggers.label: Dalco capex ~$5m/yr for new lines
triggers.quote: thumb rule $5 million represents 1 line of capacity

guidance.quote: we should be able to grow in the mid-teens rather than 10%
So we will still want to grow in the high teens and hopefully 20% plus.

red_flags.label: Debt-funded deal, leverage above comfort
red_flags.quote: The financial ratios post acquisition of Dalco-GFT is within the covenants that we have already signed in for.

evasions.quote: Let me have the goodwill number worked out for you.
